title: 第十三章 这究竟是个什么情况？

content_zh:
而需要注意的是，这并非是星象学家之间流传的古老故事或者什么浪漫传说，而是一个事实。
一个事实。
这片大陆上的每个人在诞生时都会有一颗对应自己的星辰，而这些星辰则会被记录下来进行保存和用于验证身份。而在方正眼中，这种办法就和自己世界里那些指纹和DNA验证没什么区别，不过………还是有些不同的。
而现在，方正就是来验证自己的想法。
根据脑中原本主人的记忆，方正可以确定，如果圣教之国下达通缉令，那么一定会附上这具身体本身的“星纹”。就好像抓逃犯都要进行指纹比对一样，如果自己的“星纹”与通缉犯的“星纹”一致，那么不管你打扮成什么样子，又或者变化成什么东西，都无法逃过那些执行者的眼睛。
而就在了解到这一点儿之后，方正产生了一个非常大胆的想法。
如果说，一个灵魂的诞生对应一颗星辰，那么这具身体本身的灵魂已经死去，自己的重生是否意味着这片星空上，也会重新诞生一颗属于他自己的星辰？
如果自己的猜测正确，那么只要能够获得星辰纹章，就可以彻底抹消这具身体可能残留的问题。到时候，就算圣教之国的骑士们找到自己，只要对不上星纹，那么他们也没办法抓人———圣教之国信奉秩序女神，他们不可能明目张胆的推翻自己的律法与信仰。
这就和自己世界里检方找不到对应的指纹和DNA就没办法把罪犯送上法庭一个道理，当然，如果你愿意的话，也可以打成冤假错案，但是那时候就不要怪方正心狠手辣了。
这也是方正来到这座城市的另外一个原因，正规的星辰纹章只有在城市的市政厅中才有颁发，同时这也是外来人口来这里居住时需要进行的步骤———毕竟不是每个人都会带着自己的身份文件到处乱跑，有时候只要印证一下星纹，确认不在通缉名单上，那么至少是可以得到“良民证”的。
方正脑中清晰的记得这具身体原本主人的“星纹”，而现在他所要做的，就是确认自己的“星纹”与原本主人的是否一致。如果不一致，那么计划就可以继续进行。如果一致，那么方正也可以在最短时间里离开，虽然说跑到荒郊野外与那些邪教徒和雇佣兵为伍并不是方正的本意，但如果实在不行，他也只有这条路可走了。
就是这里。
看着眼前这扇厚重的木门，方正深吸了口气，接着他伸出手去，敲了敲门。很快，门内传来了一个含混不清的声音。
“请进。”
听到对方的回应，方正伸出手去推开了厚重的木门，走进了房间。
房间内看起来有些昏暗，头顶上并不是天花板，而是圆形的，由玻璃铺成的穹顶，在墙壁的两侧摆着放满了厚重书籍的书架，让整个星象室看起来更像是一间小小的图书馆。而在房间的中央，摆放着一张沉重宽大的书桌，在书桌后面坐着一个身形矮小的人影，他披着一件黑色的长袍，卖相上来看………就和那些算命的巫师没什么太大区别。
“我是来进行星象认证的。”
方正来到书桌边，把手中的文件递了过去。而对方则坐在椅子上，动也不动的看了一眼方正放在桌子上的文件，然后点了点头。
“请把手放在水晶球上，可以开始了。”
这个星象师的声音有些低沉，不过方正倒也不是很在意，他按照对方的说话，把双手虚按在眼前的水晶球上。而紧接着，只见那个星象师也伸出了手，放在水晶球的另外一侧，随后低声念了几句咒文。

“嗡———”
下一刻，原本透明的水晶球闪烁过了一道道光亮，随后逐渐浮现出了一团漆黑，紧接着，点点的繁星在其中出现，远远望去，就好像方正曾经在电视里看过的银河系的星图差不多。只不过………这究竟是什么意思，方正自己是完全看不懂的。
但是眼前那个星象师却似乎并不是如此。在看见方正的星象之后，对方甚至不由的尖叫了一声，站起身来。
“哎？！”
“怎么了？有什么问题吗？”
看着眼前星象师的动作，方正也是内心一紧，不过他还是摆出了一副好奇的表情，注视着对方开口询问道。同时方正内心开始默默的计算自己接下来该怎么做，万一身份暴露，那么自己是直接离开？还是杀了这个星象师之后再走？

content_en:
It should be noted that this is not an old story or romantic legend circulated among astrologers, but a fact.
A fact.
Everyone on this continent will have a star corresponding to them when they are born, and these stars will be recorded, saved and used to verify identity. In Fang Zheng's eyes, this method is no different from the fingerprint and DNA verification methods in his own world, but... there are still some differences.
Now, Fang Zheng is here to verify his idea.
Based on the memory of the original owner in his mind, Founder can be sure that if the Kingdom of the Holy Religion issues a wanted order, the body's own "star pattern" will definitely be attached. Just like a fingerprint comparison is required to catch a fugitive, if your "star pattern" is consistent with the "star pattern" of a wanted criminal, then no matter how you dress up or transform into something, you will not be able to escape the eyes of those who execute you.
After learning this, Fang Zheng came up with a very bold idea.
If the birth of a soul corresponds to a star, then the soul of this body itself has died. Does his rebirth mean that a star of his own will be reborn in this starry sky?
If his guess is correct, then as long as he can obtain the star emblem, he can completely eliminate the problems that may remain in this body. At that time, even if the knights of the Kingdom of the Holy Religion find themselves, as long as they cannot match the star pattern, they will not be able to arrest people - the Kingdom of the Holy Religion believes in the goddess of order, and they cannot blatantly overthrow their own laws and beliefs.
This is the same as in our own world, the prosecutor cannot bring the criminal to court if he cannot find the corresponding fingerprints and DNA. Of course, if you want, you can make the case unjust, false or wrong, but then don't blame Fang Zheng for being ruthless.
This is another reason why Fang Zheng came to this city. Formal star coats of arms can only be issued in the city's city hall. At the same time, this is also a step that foreigners need to take when living here - after all, not everyone will run around with their own identity documents. Sometimes, as long as the star coat is confirmed and confirmed that they are not on the wanted list, they can at least get a "Certificate of Good Citizen".
Fang Zheng clearly remembered the "star pattern" of the original owner of this body in his mind, and what he had to do now was to confirm whether his "star pattern" was consistent with the original owner's. If not, then the plan can proceed. If they are consistent, then Fang Zheng can leave in the shortest possible time. Although it is not Fang Zheng's original intention to go to the wilderness to associate with those cultists and mercenaries, if it is not possible, he has the only way to go.
This is it.
Looking at the heavy wooden door in front of him, Fang Zheng took a deep breath, then reached out and knocked on the door. Soon, an indistinct voice came from the door.
"Please come in."
After hearing the other party's response, Fang Zheng reached out and pushed open the heavy wooden door and walked into the room.
The room looked a little dark. There was not a ceiling above the head, but a circular dome made of glass. There were bookshelves filled with heavy books on both sides of the wall, making the entire astrology room look more like a small library. In the center of the room, there was a heavy and wide desk. Behind the desk sat a short figure. He was wearing a black robe. From the looks of it, he looked like... not much different from those fortune-telling wizards.
"I'm here for astrology certification."
Fang Zheng came to the desk and handed over the document in his hand. The other person sat on the chair, glanced at the documents Fang Zheng placed on the table, and then nodded.
"Please put your hand on the crystal ball, you are ready to begin."
This astrologer's voice is a bit deep, noGuo Fangzheng didn't really care. He followed what the other party said and pressed his hands on the crystal ball in front of him. Immediately afterwards, the astrologer also stretched out his hand, placed it on the other side of the crystal ball, and then whispered a few mantras.
"Buzz——"
The next moment, the originally transparent crystal ball flashed with light, and then gradually emerged into a mass of darkness. Then, dots of stars appeared in it. From a distance, it looked like the star map of the Milky Way that Fang Zheng had seen on TV. But... Fang Zheng himself couldn't understand what this meant.
But the astrologer in front of me didn't seem to be like this. After seeing the square star, the other party couldn't help but scream and stood up.
"Huh?!"
"What's wrong? Is there a problem?"
Seeing the movements of the astrologer in front of him, Fang Zheng felt nervous, but he still put on a curious expression, looked at the other person and asked. At the same time, Fang Zheng began to silently calculate what he should do next. If his identity was exposed, would he leave directly? Or should I kill this astrologer before leaving?
